description: Further refinement rounds of the pilot: from round 2 on, the manager gives concrete feedback. Each round refines the previous round's delivered result; every KPI not listed under reject is accepted. Feedback is fixed per rejected KPI.
after_max_rounds: round max_rounds is the last round: a case is recorded as reached_after_<max_rounds>_rounds or not_converged_after_<max_rounds>_rounds

feedback_sentences.P2P_INVOICE_CONCRETE: Concretely: I want the time between the moment the step right before 'Release Supplier's Invoice' is finished — whatever that step happens to be in each case — and the moment the release itself starts. Not the time since any quotation or dispute step.
feedback_sentences.P2P_CYCLE_CONCRETE: Concretely: count from the moment 'Create Purchase Requisition' happens until 'Pay invoice' is done. Not from the request for quotation.
feedback_sentences.P2P_INVOICE_CONCRETE_R3: Almost. I don't want how long the previous step takes. I want the gap after it: from the moment that previous step is finished until the moment 'Release Supplier's Invoice' starts — like you did for the cycle time, just between those two moments.

reject: Total Cycle Time from Requisition to Invoice Payment
